notes.made: George Evelyn produced it with Robin Taylor-Firth. The track is built on multiple elements of "Private Number", the 1968 duet by Judy Clay and William Bell, which runs all the way through it.
notes.context: Evelyn started Nightmares on Wax in Leeds in 1988, and "Dextrous" was only the second release on Warp, in 1989, selling 30,000 copies. By the 2010s Time Out and Future Music were calling him the label's longest-serving act. In a Space Outta Sound came out on 7 March 2006 and reached 93 in the UK and 12 on the US dance albums chart. "You Wish" wasn't one of its three singles.

listen_for.note: The Judy Clay and William Bell record isn't a one-off stab. WhoSampled lists multiple elements of "Private Number" running across the track.

leads_to.title: Private Number
leads_to.why: The duet the whole track sits on.
